data.name: Sagar
data.gender_notes: Sagar is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sāgara, 'ocean, sea'. Its root is Sanskrit sāgara (सागर). A classical Sanskrit term for the ocean. Sagar is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ocean; sea”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sagar expresses “Ocean; sea”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sagar total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word सागर (sāgara), meaning 'ocean'. In Hindu mythology, Sagar is the name of a great sage and the king of the seas. He is also the father of the sage Kapila and the grandfather of the great sage Bhagiratha.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for the ocean.
